result:
The build succeeds cleanly. All three missing operations — `EscapeField`, `JoinRow`, and `SplitRow` — are now implemented in `CsvRow.calr`, matching the existing conventions (inline signatures, effect annotations, mutable-binding `~` prefix, indent-only blocks). `NeedsQuoting` is unchanged.

The implementation satisfies the spec:
- **`EscapeField`** returns the field verbatim when `NeedsQuoting` is false, otherwise wraps in double-quotes with internal quotes doubled.
- **`JoinRow`** escapes each field and joins with commas; the empty list yields `""`.
- **`SplitRow`** parses a well-formed row back into fields, handling quoted sections (doubled quotes → one literal quote, commas/CR/LF inside quotes as content) and trailing-comma empty fields; the empty line parses to a single empty field.

This makes `SplitRow(JoinRow(fields))` round-trip for every non-empty field list, with the empty-list exception noted in the spec.
